d:
This month, I set myself a goal of publishing 3 comics, so I wanted to squeeze in one more before October comes to an end!

For this one, I decided to make a simple little comic featuring a Street Fighter 6 pairing I really like. I know they're not canon, but I just love how they look together! ❤️

Feel free to leave a comment telling me which characters or pairing you'd like to see in my next comic, or just let me know what you think of this one in general. I'd love to hear your thoughts!

Thanks for reading, and I hope you enjoy it!
